underlines.text: I have already told her so once, by your desire.

reference.text: Mr. Darcy was writing, and Miss Bingley, seated near him, was watching the progress of his letter, and repeatedly calling off his attention by messages to his sister.

underlines.text: a person who can write a long letter with ease

reference.text: The perpetual commendations of the lady either on his hand-writing, or on the evenness of his lines, or on the length of his letter, with the perfect unconcern with which her praises were received, formed a curious dialogue, and was exactly in unison with her opinion of each.

underlines.text: because he does not write with ease
